optimization_experiments.objective: One fixed legal A basis input; exact decoded 1/2 squared Euclidean loss to (0,2)
optimization_experiments.gradient_scope: Gradient of the continuous linear squared-loss extension at decoded endpoints, not derivative of target-format rounding
optimization_experiments.comparison_limit: Dense and structural routes have different parameterizations/domains; no performance, generalization or universal convergence claim

arithmetic.BF16: software Fraction RNE multiply/add; exact Fraction accumulator
arithmetic.FP32: CPU NumPy scalar multiply/add, dtype=float32, every result audited by rational RNE
arithmetic.rounding: nearest, ties to even; gradual underflow; every arithmetic zero becomes +0

environment.optimizer_proposals: Separately specified by B1; protected arithmetic metadata does not certify host optimizer operations.

arithmetic.BF16: software Fraction RNE multiply/add; exact Fraction accumulator
arithmetic.FP32: CPU NumPy scalar multiply/add, dtype=float32, every result audited by rational RNE
arithmetic.rounding: nearest, ties to even; gradual underflow; every arithmetic zero becomes +0

environment.optimizer_proposals: Separately specified by B1; protected arithmetic metadata does not certify host optimizer operations.

evidence_scope.exact: Finite checks corroborate handwritten conditional projection/parameterization/transaction proofs.
evidence_scope.optimization: Toy declared A objectives, actual stored endpoints and complete local D domains; no universal learning or long-term guarantee.
evidence_scope.optimizer: Declared host proposal arithmetic is separate from protected BF16/FP32 execution.
evidence_scope.BF16: Software RNE, not native BF16 certification.
evidence_scope.FP32: Local scalar CPU operations audited against exact rational RNE.
evidence_scope.transactions: Trusted serial combined-state publication and refusal rollback; no cryptographic caller authentication or general concurrency.
evidence_scope.excluded: GPU, arbitrary compiler optimization, process-failure atomicity, full machine proof and later P2 stages.
